titleEn: Maximum Area of a Piece of Cake After Horizontal and Vertical Cuts
title: 切割后蛋糕的最大面积
summary: 在高 h、宽 w 的矩形蛋糕上按给定坐标横切和竖切，返回最大块面积取模。
insight: 最大矩形块由最大水平间距与最大垂直间距组合；分别排序切线并把两端边界纳入间距计算。
pitfalls: 要计算边界到首尾切线的距离

solutions.title: 最大间距乘积
solutions.idea: 独立求两个方向切割坐标的最大相邻差。
steps: gap(length,cuts) 比较 0、所有切线及 length 之间相邻差

code.java: class Solution { private int gap(int length,int[] cuts){Arrays.sort(cuts);int previous=0,maximum=0;for(int cut:cuts){maximum=Math.max(maximum,cut-previous);previous=cut;}return Math.max(maximum,length-previous);}public int maxArea(int h,int w,int[] horizontalCuts,int[] verticalCuts){return (int)((long)gap(h,horizontalCuts)*gap(w,verticalCuts)%1_000_000_007L);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun gap(length:Int,cuts:IntArray):Int{cuts.sort();var previous=0;var maximum=0;for(cut in cuts){maximum=maxOf(maximum,cut-previous);previous=cut};return maxOf(maximum,length-previous)};fun maxArea(h:Int,w:Int,horizontalCuts:IntArray,verticalCuts:IntArray):Int=(gap(h,horizontalCuts).toLong()*gap(w,verticalCuts)%1_000_000_007L).toInt() }
code.cpp: class Solution { int gap(int length,vector<int>& cuts){sort(cuts.begin(),cuts.end());int previous=0,maximum=0;for(int cut:cuts){maximum=max(maximum,cut-previous);previous=cut;}return max(maximum,length-previous);}public:int maxArea(int h,int w,vector<int>& horizontalCuts,vector<int>& verticalCuts){return 1LL*gap(h,horizontalCuts)*gap(w,verticalCuts)%1000000007;} };
